ai.title: AI Culinary Assistant
ai.subtitle: Smart tips and recipes
ai.chef_greeting:
Hello! I am **Chef AI** – your personal gourmet culinary assistant. 🧑‍🍳

I see you have **{{count}} items** in your pantry. I can suggest recipes from our selection, fully customized to your dietary preferences, exclusions, and allergies.

What would you like to cook today?
ai.fallback_expiring_with_items: The following items in your pantry are expiring soon: **{{names}}**. I recommend cooking one of these recipes to reduce food waste:
ai.fallback_expiring_none: You don't have any items expiring in the next 3 days. Here are the best recipe suggestions using your pantry items:
ai.fallback_keto: Sure thing! Here are our top **Keto** recipes matching your dietary profile:
ai.fallback_vegan: Here are our curated **Vegan** options containing no animal products:
ai.fallback_substitutions:
As your culinary assistant, here are some essential substitution guidelines:

* **Eggs (in baking)**: Mix 1 tbsp ground chia or flaxseeds with 3 tbsp water, let it sit, or use 1/4 cup applesauce.
* **Dairy**: Replace cooking cream with coconut cream, and milk with oat, almond, or soy milk.
* **Butter**: Can be replaced 1-to-1 with coconut oil or mashed avocado.
* **Gluten**: Substitute wheat flour with gluten-free flour blends (rice, almond, or tapioca starch).
ai.network_error_details: Network request failed (Failed to fetch). Likely caused by browser CORS block or no internet connection.
ai.fallback_error:
I am running in **Local Offline Mode** because the Gemini API connection failed.

⚠️ **Error Details:** `{{error}}`

However, I have scanned your ingredients and dietary filters. Based on your pantry, I recommend trying these recipes:

Based on your pantry, I recommend trying these recipes:

ai.settings_modal_desc: Enter your personal Gemini API Key to enable the full conversational LLM model. The key is saved locally in your browser.
ai.view_full_guide_link: View full guide for a free key
ai.guide_modal_desc: To unlock full interactive chat capability with Chef AI, you need to set up a personal Gemini API Key. Follow our simple 4-step setup:
ai.guide_step1_title: Log in to Google AI Studio
ai.guide_step1_text: Open [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/) and sign in with your personal Google account (Gmail).
ai.guide_step2_text: In the top left, click the "Get API key" button, then click the blue button "Create API key".
ai.guide_step3_text: A code starting with "AIzaSy..." will appear. Click "Copy" on the right. Keep this code private!
ai.guide_step4_text: Close this guide, open Settings ⚙️ in the header above, paste your key, and click "Save Key".
ai.faq_a1: Yes! Google provides a generous free tier of 15 queries per minute for Gemini 3.5 Flash for personal use. No credit card or billing configuration is required.
ai.faq_a2: The key is saved locally in your browser's localStorage. We do not store or transmit it to our servers. Your chat requests are sent directly from your device to the Google API endpoint.
ai.faq_q3: What is Gourmet Rule Engine (Offline mode)?
ai.faq_a3: If you do not have a key or if your key is restricted (yielding a 403 error), Chef AI switches to our custom local algorithm. It automatically filters recipes and outputs suggestions adjusted to your pantry and diet without using the internet.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1_text: By accessing and using "The Best Idea Eatery" application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you should not use the application.
terms.section2_text: The Best Idea Eatery is a platform for recipe management, food inventory tracking, and culinary inspiration. The service includes Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools for recipe generation and product scanning.
terms.section3_text: To access certain features (e.g., cloud recipe storage), registration is required. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities under your account.
terms.section4_text: All recipes, text, graphics, and logos in the app are property of "The Best Idea Eatery" or its licensors. User content remains the property of the user, but grants the app a license to display it within the platform.
terms.section5_text: The application is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that services will be uninterrupted or error-free. Recipes and nutritional advice provided by AI are for informational purposes only.
terms.section6_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Your continued use of the app after changes are made will constitute acceptance of the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_text: We collect information when you register, log in to your account, add recipes or products to your pantry. This information may include your name, email address, and profile data.
privacy.section2_text: Your data is used to personalize your experience, improve our services, and ensure access to your content from multiple devices.
privacy.section3_text: Your personal data and content are securely stored on Google's cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud Platform / Firebase). We implement various security measures to keep your personal information protected.
privacy.section4_text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time.
privacy.section4_notice: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time through your profile settings.
privacy.section5_text: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties, except to trusted third parties who assist us in operating our application (such as Google for storage services).
privacy.section6_text: We use local storage (localStorage) to save your preferences and session. If you use the app as a guest, your data is stored only locally on your device.
